title: Power-series ring lifts agreeing on base parameters
statement: Let $R=\Lambda_R[[X_1,\ldots,X_n]]$ and $T=\Lambda_T[[Y_1,\ldots,Y_m]]$ be regular local power-series rings [def-weil-pbc-multivariate-power-series, def-weil-regular-scheme], and $i:R\to T$ a local ring map. Let $t$ be a list in $R$ and $y$ a list in $T$ such that $i(t),y$ is a regular system of parameters [def-weil-pbc-regular-system-of-parameters]. Assume either both coefficient rings are characteristic-zero fields, or both are Cohen rings for the same prime $p$ [def-weil-pbc-cohen-ring] and $t$ begins with $p$. For any commutative $R$-algebra $D$, square-zero ideal $J$, and $R$-algebra map $g:T\to D/J$ killing a positive power of the maximal ideal of $T$ [def-weil-pbc-formally-smooth-adic, def-weil-pbc-algebra-hom-quotient], there exists a ring map $f:T\to D$ with $qf=g$ and $f(i(r))=r_D$ for every entry $r$ of $t$. This asserts parameter agreement only, not $R$-linearity.

source.place: Tags 07NQ, 07NM and 07NL, coordinate change and construction of the unrestricted parameter-preserving lift

proof.text: The canonical variable ideal, with p added in the Cohen case, is contained in the target maximal ideal. Apply the field/Cohen ring lifting theorem to obtain an unrestricted ring lift f0 in the universe of D.

Use the parameter-quotient theorem with the empty quotient list to identify T with power series in i(t),y over its coefficients, omitting p in the Cohen case. Compose the supplied equivalence with the quotient-by-zero equivalence.

Keep the coefficient map of f0. On coordinates belonging to i(t), prescribe their base images in D; retain f0 values on the other coordinates. Each coordinate has a k-th power in J and a 2k-th power zero. The ideal generated by the finitely many values is nilpotent, so D is complete for it. Evaluate by the complete power-series universal property. Apply the same uniqueness theorem in D/J to prove qf=g. The p-entry agrees automatically because ring maps preserve integers; list indexing proves agreement on all other entries.

theorem exists_parameterPreserving_ringLift
    (ΛR : Type u) (ΛT : Type v) [CommRing ΛR] [CommRing ΛT] (n m : ℕ)
    [IsRegularLocalRing (MvPowerSeries (Fin n) ΛR)]
    [IsRegularLocalRing (MvPowerSeries (Fin m) ΛT)]
    (i : MvPowerSeries (Fin n) ΛR →+* MvPowerSeries (Fin m) ΛT) [IsLocalHom i]
    (t : List (MvPowerSeries (Fin n) ΛR))
    (y : List (MvPowerSeries (Fin m) ΛT))
    (hy : IsRegularSystemOfParameters (t.map i ++ y))
    (hcoeff : (IsField ΛR ∧ IsField ΛT ∧ CharZero ΛR ∧ CharZero ΛT) ∨
      ∃ p : ℕ, p.Prime ∧ IsCohenRing p ΛR ∧ IsCohenRing p ΛT ∧
        t.head? = some (p : MvPowerSeries (Fin n) ΛR)) :
    let R := MvPowerSeries (Fin n) ΛR
    let T := MvPowerSeries (Fin m) ΛT
    letI : Algebra R T := i.toAlgebra
    ∀ (D : Type w) [CommRing D] [Algebra R D] (J : Ideal D), J ^ 2 = ⊥ →
      ∀ g : T →ₐ[R] D ⧸ J,
      (∃ k : ℕ, 1 ≤ k ∧ ∀ x ∈ maximalIdeal T ^ k, g x = 0) →
      ∃ f : T →+* D, (Ideal.Quotient.mk J).comp f = g.toRingHom ∧
        ∀ r ∈ t, f (i r) = algebraMap R D r
